epic.title: Fix Da Yun branch audit in module1_macro.py
deliverables: Rewrite Da Yun branch audit (module1_macro.py:216-249) to support all 8 interaction types in canonical order, apply graduated magnitudes, check all natal branches, and apply polarity based on target branch element / combined element.

user_stories.story: As a system designer, I want the Da Yun branch audit to reflect canonical interaction priority and follow medication/taboo polarity rules so that macro environmental results are calculated correctly.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 interactions checked in priority order.
Clashing 忌神 flips to positive outcome magnitude.
No early break when checking natal branches.
definition_of_done: Calculations run perfectly without runtime errors.
Ruff checks and formatting are complaint and clean.
No legacy logic remains in target modified areas.
acceptance_criteria: The Da Yun branch audit scans all 8 earthly branch interactions in canonical priority order (三会 > 三合 > 冲 > 六合 > 半合 > 刑 > 害 > 破).
The audit checks all four natal branches for each interaction type without early breaks (no breakout on first natal branch).
Polarity logic is applied to flip clashing/harming 忌神 elements to positive (relief) and combining 忌神 elements to negative (bad).
The _unified_medicine and _unified_taboo sets are computed before the Da Yun branch audit and reused without recomputation.
Code check and format via ruff pass without errors.

cells.criterion: Da Yun branch audit logic is correctly implemented according to canonical priority and polarity rules.
cells.evidence: The plan specifies moving the _unified_medicine and _unified_taboo sets before the audit, checking all 8 interaction types without early breaks, using correct elements for polarity checks, and keeping legacy annual Tai Sui sections untouched.

draft.summary: Refactor `src2/engine/module1_macro.py`'s Da Yun branch audit to use the canonical interaction priorities, evaluate all 8 interaction types (now adding 三会 and 半合), check target branch elements correctly for clash/harm polarisms versus combined elements for combos, and make sure that we scan all natal branches.

subtasks.title: Refactor Da Yun branch audit in module1_macro.py
subtasks.instruction: Move lines 343-348 (setup of _unified_medicine and _unified_taboo) before the Da Yun branch audit (line 216). Replace the Da Yun branch audit (lines 216-249) with a sequence checking the 8 earthly branch interactions in canonical priority order: 三会 > 三合 > 冲 > 六合 > 半合 > 刑 > 害 > 破. For clash/harm types (冲, 刑, 害, 破), check target natal branch element against _unified_taboo / _unified_medicine. For combination types (三会, 三合, 六合, 半合), check combined element against _unified_taboo / _unified_medicine. Set ty_branch_impact using the graduated magnitudes and the polarity sign, scanning all natal branches without early breaks. Import BAN_HE_RESULTS and Element from src2.core.schemas.unified.
subtasks.acceptance: Ruff check passes, all 8 interaction types checked in correct priority order using the combined elements for combination types and natal branch elements for clash/harm types, and proper polarity logic applied.

evidence.content: Da Yun branch audit is currently implemented on lines 216-249 with incorrect priority order, missing 三会/半合, and early break statements. _unified_medicine and _unified_taboo are defined on lines 343-348.

risks: Inverting the polarity could result in incorrect interpretation of clashing 忌神 (relief) or combining 忌神.
Improper import of BAN_HE_RESULTS or Element from unified.py could lead to circular imports or module failures.

strategy.how_to_fix: Move lines 343-348 (definition of _unified_medicine and _unified_taboo) to before the Da Yun branch audit block (around line 216). Then rewrite the Da Yun branch audit to sequentially look up 三会, 三合, 冲, 六合, 半合, 刑, 害, 破 using the imported registries. For clash/harm types, resolve polarity using the element of the affected natal branch. For combination types, resolve polarity using the element of the combination. Map the result to ty_branch_impact.
